changeSet.author: tchoi-rs
changeSet.comment: Deleting a community used to leave its lab groups in no community (RSDEV-1464). Attach every lab group (groupType 0) without a community to the default community (-1), then realign the denormalised rsGroup.communityId of lab groups with their community. Idempotent. Irreversible.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO community_labGroups (community_id, group_id) SELECT -1, g.id FROM rsGroup g WHERE g.groupType = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM community_labGroups c WHERE c.group_id = g.id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Community WHERE id = -1);
